detail: Add an e2e case with a selected brand, inStock=true and enough matching seeded products for two pages. Navigate to page 2 and assert that brand and inStock remain in the URL, the filters remain active, and the exact products and count match the seeded selection.

After clicking 'In stock only' and on every Next-page click, the 'Now at <url>' / 'Page n of 10 at <url>' captions never appear in any keyframe (01-step, 02-08, 26-28 show no caption), so the video never shows inStock=true in the URL. Per-page highlight frames also show only the first 6 card names (the third row's names are below the fold), so the 'no out-of-stock name on each page' check is only partly visible. [raised by opus, sol]

The case expects brand=1, type=3 and inStock=true in the address bar. The 'Now at' caption set after the third click never shows in a keyframe (04-step and later have no caption), so no frame shows the URL.
Only the pre-click 'Opened ?type=3&inStock=true' caption appears (01). After clicking page 2 no frame shows a URL with page=2 (03-step has no caption).
After clicking page 2, no frame shows the URL with type=3, inStock=true and page=2 (07/08/09 have no caption), so the 'survives paging' part is shown only by the cards.

The case expects none of brand, type or inStock in the address bar after Clear all filters. The 'Now at' caption never appears (03-step shows the hero with no caption), so the cleared URL is never shown.
After clicking the empty state's 'Clear all filters', no keyframe shows the resulting URL without brand, type or inStock. The 'Now at' caption is missing.
The case expects no inStock and brand=1 kept. 02-step and later frames show no 'Now at' caption, so the URL change is never shown on video.

05-absent 'no GripTrek Hiking Poles on page 1' is scrolled so the first card row (Alpine Fusion, Maverick, Omni-Snow), where GripTrek would sort, is out of view. The frame does not show the place where the element would be. In addition, after the In-stock and page-2 clicks no frame shows the URL with brand=3, inStock=true and page=2.
The Playwright API test repeats the C# functional test's request and stock, count, paging and exclusion assertions without exercising another behavior.
The Playwright API test repeats the C# boundary request, exact IDs, stock-one assertion and stock-zero exclusions.
The Playwright API test repeats the C# explicit-false request, total, data length and required-item assertions.
The Playwright API test repeats the C# v1 request, total, data length and out-of-stock-item inclusion assertions.

The test asserts product-name order on both pages but never reads or asserts the specified prices. Captions such as '699.00 first' and '499.00 down to 79.99' are hardcoded narration, so incorrect displayed prices can pass.

The post-reload catalog highlight leaves the first row outside the viewport and obscures lower product names with the URL caption. The designated no-out-of-stock capture does not make the complete asserted list readable.

DELETE TEST TC-INSTK-1-05 v2 items list without inStock is unchanged: The Playwright API test repeats the C# functional test's unfiltered v2 request, total, data length, zero-stock inclusions and name-order check. Delete the Playwright duplicate; the C# test retains every expected result.

The post-clear stock-option highlight and final frame leave the option against the bottom viewport edge with its lower portion clipped. Capture the settled scroll position with the complete inactive option visible.

DELETE TEST : The C# test repeats the stack API test's version, query, status, count, pagination, exact IDs and exclusions. The stack test additionally checks exact product names; deleting the C# duplicate preserves every expected result.

DELETE TEST : The C# test repeats the stack API test's version, combined-filter query, status, count, exact IDs and brand/type assertions. The stack test additionally checks exact product names; deleting the C# duplicate preserves every expected result.

TC-INSTK-1-08 is implemented twice: the C# test and the stack Playwright test both GET /openapi/v2.json and /openapi/v1.json, assert 200, then check the same inStock fields (query, not required, boolean) and its absence in v1. Only the Playwright one also checks content-type application/json. Earlier rounds removed the duplicates for TC-01/02/05/06/07 (SOL-TV001..005) and TC-03/04 (SOL-TV006/007); this one is left.

Frame 12 is captioned 'active filters: 3', but the page is scrolled so the Filters header and its count are under the sticky site header. The count 3 is visible in frame 03, so the case is still proven on video; only this narrated frame shows nothing.

DELETE TEST TC-INSTK-1-08 OpenAPI v2 document describes inStock; v1 document does not: The Playwright API test repeats the C# functional test's anonymous OpenAPI requests, statuses, optional boolean query-parameter assertions for v2, and exclusion assertion for v1. Its JSON content-type check adds no distinct filter behavior; remove this duplicate and retain the C# test.

The page-2 row-1 capture shows Shadow Black Snowboard, but the floating circular widget covers its expected $379.00 price. The following row capture and final frames clip that price beneath the sticky header. Center the complete first row before recording so every specified name and price is readable.
